checkpoint_selection.candidate_set: positive epochs satisfying every source promotion and coverage constraint
tie_break: minimum source-validation scene-macro absolute relevance loss
minimum source-validation scene-macro continuous pairwise relevance loss
maximum v1 p05 row-mean all-view cosine
promotion_constraints: auxiliary macro strictly improves over epoch zero
absolute relevance macro strictly improves over epoch zero
absolute relevance does not regress on either held-out source scene
continuous pairwise relevance macro strictly improves over epoch zero
all frozen V1 fidelity non-regression checks pass
minimum held-out active-over-eligible row coverage is at least 0.95
minimum held-out any-trainable-endpoint pair coverage is at least 0.95
checkpoint_selection.zero_passing_epoch_policy: write diagnostic best-raw-aux and final states but no deployment checkpoint

hard_negative_denominators.continuous_pairwise_training: authority pairs having at least one trainable endpoint
hard_negative_denominators.triplet_training: authority pairs whose anchor is trainable
hard_negative_denominators.validation: all authority pairs for both pairwise and triplet

saved_states: promotion-selected deployment state when one exists

method_scope: source-only; exact same frozen four-train/two-validation authority and assets as V2.1
